interface.shortDescription: Search CERN Open Data, fetch records, files, analysis environments, CMS good-run lists, HLT paths.
interface.longDescription: Read the CERN Open Data Portal, the public archive of collision, simulated and derived datasets, analysis software, environments and documentation from ALICE, ATLAS, CMS, LHCb and other experiments. Search it with exact-vocabulary filters (experiment, record type, physics category, keyword, collision energy and type, file format, year, event count, availability, collection, LHCb magnet polarity and stripping) and live facet counts; open records by recid, DOI, CMS dataset path or documentation slug, each with its license and a ready citation; page through file manifests for XRootD URIs and HTTPS download URLs; and assemble a record's analysis environment: container images, CMSSW release, global tag, condition and VM records, example software, and quoted guide sections. For CMS data it also returns validated-run (good-run) lists and High-Level Trigger path records. A reference tool decodes the portal's vocabulary. No API key required, and requests are paced under the portal's limit of 60 a minute. Dataset metadata and data are CC0 under the CERN Open Data Terms of Use; software, container images and guide code are licensed per record.
